newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan constructions shares fall on typhoon damage.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan constructions shares fall on typhoon damage.

text.p: Taiwan's construction shares fell at mid-session on Tuesday reflecting concerns over damages inflicted by typhoon Winnie, brokers said.
* Construction index down 0.51 percent at 0230 GMT. Overall benchmark index up 0.87 percent.
* Pao-Ku Co loses daily seven-percent limit or T$2.80 to T$37.50.
* Typhoon Winnie swept through northern Taiwan on Monday and Tuesday, killing at least 25 people and causing landslides that toppled numerous buildings.
* No official damage estimate available yet.
